data.narrative:
UFORCE, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company, commands a current post-money valuation of $1.0B against $50M in total capital raised. The valuation rests on a peer universe of 13 same-sector comparables spanning similar valuation tiers, with two public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI. The comparable set ranges from $300M to $4.5B, with a median of $1.2B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $2.5B valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company Defense & Security cohort supports a $1.2B implied value, anchored to the last post-money round. The two methods produce a weighted triangulated range of $1.1B (low), $1.9B (median), and $2.9B (high).

The median $1.9B valuation sits materially above the current $1.0B post-money, consistent with the capital intensity and growth requirements typical of frontier defense tech. Primary uncertainties include the maturity and revenue traction of the peer set relative to UFORCE's product stage, and macro-level volatility in defense-sector funding appetite. The current $1.0B valuation appears defensible at the lower bound of the derived range, with material step-up potential contingent on near-term operational milestones.
